verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents that each supported framework, including SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA, gets control mapping to framework requirements, with automated evidence collection, and that controls map automatically to CMMC requirements. That is a first-party control-mapping capability, but the evidence never says that one set of controls or evidence is reused across frameworks or that overlap is surfaced. missing for 10: explicit cross-framework control/evidence reuse (SOC 2 work counting toward ISO 27001/HIPAA), an overlap or crosswalk view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, controls and evidence map ACROSS frameworks — work done for SOC 2 counts toward ISO 27001 and HIPAA automatically, with the overlap shown

citations.quote: Each supported framework includes control mapping to framework requirements, automated control testing that collects compliance evidence from integrated technologies
Map controls to CMMC requirements automatically to identify gaps and readiness status
